name: ASJP — Algerian Scientific Journals Platform
notes: National platform of Algeria (CERIST), ~931 journals, full text open access. Registry-only for now: the server closed every connection from the build sandbox during the 2026-11-26 probe (curl and urllib, http and https), so no search route could be verified live.

name: IASJ — Iraqi Academic Scientific Journals
notes: National platform of Iraq (Ministry of Higher Education), ~505 journals, open access full text; old domain iasj.net. Registry-only for now: the server closed every connection from the build sandbox during the 2026-11-26 probe, so no search route could be verified live.

name: PRSM — Portal of Moroccan Scientific Journals (IMIST)
notes: National journals portal of Morocco (IMIST/CNRST), 380+ journals, open access, DOI prefix 10.48399/IMIST.PRSM. Live search wired in build_article.py (search_arab_platforms) via the portal JSON API on prsm.imist.ma; article URLs resolve on revues.imist.ma.

name: EKB Journals — Egyptian Knowledge Bank journal platform
notes: Egyptian university journals hosted on *.journals.ekb.eg (mostly OJS). Registry-only for now: journal subdomains answered HTTP 429 'Access Restricted' and the main site closed connections from the build sandbox during the 2026-11-26 probe, so no search route could be verified live.

name: QScience — HBKU Press (Qatar)
notes: Open-access publishing platform of Hamad Bin Khalifa University Press, Qatar (diamond OA). Registry-only for now: the site is a JavaScript single-page app whose HTML shell carries no searchable content and no machine-usable search route answered during the 2026-11-26 probe; its articles remain reachable via Crossref/DOAJ.

name: Dirasat — University of Jordan journals portal
notes: Dirasat journal family of the University of Jordan (OJS), open access, Scopus-indexed series. Live search wired in build_article.py (search_arab_platforms) via the OJS site-wide search.

name: An-Najah Journals — An-Najah National University (Palestine)
notes: Open-access journals of An-Najah National University, Palestine (Natural Sciences A, Humanities B, Medical and Pharmaceutical Journal). Live search wired in build_article.py (search_arab_platforms) via the per-journal search (slugs anujr-a, anujr-b, pmpj).

name: KnE Publishing — Knowledge E (UAE)
notes: Open-access publisher based in Dubai (CC BY), hosting journals and proceedings from across the Arab region. Live search wired in build_article.py (search_arab_platforms) via the platform search API on kneopen.com; article landing pages resolve on knepublishing.com and every article carries a Crossref DOI.
